requirements.quote:
Event 13: IdleHoldTimer_Expires

         Definition: An event generated when the IdleHoldTimer expires,
                     indicating that the BGP connection has completed
                     waiting for the back-off period to prevent BGP peer
                     oscillation.
requirements.condition: IdleHoldTimer_Expires is supported and IdleHoldTimer expires.
requirements.required_behavior: Generate IdleHoldTimer_Expires to indicate completion of the back-off waiting period.
requirements.why_checkable: Timer expiry and resulting event dispatch can be checked together.

requirements.quote:
The IdleHoldTimer is only used when the persistent
                     peer oscillation damping function is enabled by
                     setting the DampPeerOscillations optional attribute
                     to TRUE.
requirements.condition: The persistent peer oscillation damping function is not enabled by setting DampPeerOscillations to TRUE.
requirements.why_checkable: Timer activation can be checked against the damping enable attribute.

requirements.quote:
Implementations not implementing the persistent
                     peer oscillation damping function may not have the
                     IdleHoldTimer.
requirements.condition: The implementation does not implement persistent peer oscillation damping.
requirements.why_checkable: Timer availability and damping support determine whether omission is permitted.

requirements.quote:
Event 13: IdleHoldTimer_Expires

         Definition: An event generated when the IdleHoldTimer expires,
                     indicating that the BGP connection has completed
                     waiting for the back-off period to prevent BGP peer
                     oscillation.

Rekhter, et al.             Standards Track                    [Page 46]

RFC 4271                         BGP-4                      January 2006

                     The IdleHoldTimer is only used when the persistent
                     peer oscillation damping function is enabled by
                     setting the DampPeerOscillations optional attribute
                     to TRUE.

                     Implementations not implementing the persistent
                     peer oscillation damping function may not have the
                     IdleHoldTimer.

         Status:     Optional
requirements.why_checkable: The FSM event capability can be inspected; omission of this optional event is permitted.

requirements.quote:
Optional
         Attribute
         Status:     If this event occurs:
                     1) DampPeerOscillations attribute SHOULD be set to
                        TRUE.
                     2) IdleHoldTimer SHOULD have just expired.
requirements.required_behavior: DampPeerOscillations SHOULD be set to TRUE.
requirements.why_checkable: Read the damping attribute at event dispatch.

requirements.quote:
Optional
         Attribute
         Status:     If this event occurs:
                     1) DampPeerOscillations attribute SHOULD be set to
                        TRUE.
                     2) IdleHoldTimer SHOULD have just expired.
requirements.why_checkable: Correlate the event timestamp with timer expiry.
